up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for distinct molecules that have been tested in assays where the assay organism is 'Homo sapiens' and the assay target is CHEMBL2971 (Tyrosine-protein kinase JAK2). Filter the assays on assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and return the molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles columns.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971'
  AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
